info.title: Docker Agent
info.description: Interactive Docker Agent API. Execute requests against this agent. Engine webhooks return 202 acknowledgments; prune and SSH key mutations complete synchronously.

get.summary: Register the manager connection or synchronize host inventories

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Management server URL; omit to synchronize without changing configuration

post.description: Delete stopped containers matching the filters. Attached volumes are retained. Synchronous: HTTP 200 means Docker completed the operation. Uses API Basic authentication. When configured, sends a best-effort host journal callback. Use returned deletion identifiers to reconcile manager inventory. Overlapping agent operations return 409. Filters use Docker string-array syntax.

409.description: Another agent operation or Docker prune is in progress

post.description: Delete unused dangling images by default. all=true includes unused tagged images. Synchronous: HTTP 200 means Docker completed the operation. Uses API Basic authentication. When configured, sends a best-effort host journal callback. Use returned deletion identifiers to reconcile manager inventory. Overlapping agent operations return 409. Filters use Docker string-array syntax.

409.description: Another agent operation or Docker prune is in progress

post.description: Delete unused anonymous volumes by default. all=true includes unused named volumes and their data. Synchronous: HTTP 200 means Docker completed the operation.
